QUOTE: Rust, JS/TS, shell and CMake files have no doxygen front end. Their extensions are routed in `harvest.py` and `synth.py` instead.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says doxygen filters by FILE_PATTERNS and mentions other languages routed separately, but it doesn't state that a file reaches the index only if something can read it. It also doesn't name the parse-built front end claiming the file types doxygen can't read as a filter on the resolved scope, and it never mentions binary classification dropping files with misleading extensions.
